top_strength: Jevic gathered comprehensive logistics details efficiently and accurately, covering special items, property types, floor plans, garage storage, access concerns, furniture inventory, box count estimates, and destination property configuration.
coaching_note: Jevic must deliver the Two Concerns question and both promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) early in the call before moving to probing — these steps are load-bearing and were completely skipped here, and he also needs to proactively frame the rate lock and ask for the business rather than waiting for the customer to volunteer a booking.
